description: Intendencia de Montevideo, Servicio Planificación Gestión y Diseño publishes georeferenced point layers of street furniture placed in public spaces of Montevideo: benches, public toilets, litter bins, drinking fountains, bicycle racks and clock-thermometers, with a text description of the fields; the page says the data are generated daily so the layer is current to the previous day. Coverage: the city of Montevideo; the portal record was last modified on 2024-05-15. Format and access: Shapefile, TXT, downloadable without registration from the Uruguay national open data catalogue; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licencia de DAG de Uruguay; cost: free. Caveats: the shapefiles were not opened, so counts and attribute fields are unconfirmed; the layers give locations of furniture, not park boundaries or condition. Simulation uses: public-space asset inventories for maintenance and heat-stress or flood-exposure studies of street furniture, and pedestrian amenity accessibility analysis. Related catalogue records: Montevideo cadastral parcels with land-use plan attributes (building heights, setbacks, occupation factors) (data-montevideo-cadastral-parcels-land-use-plan); Montevideo public tree census 2005 to 2008 (Censo de arbolado) (data-montevideo-tree-census-2008); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
